title: Recreate your original key images in a 70s–80s anime style first, then use…
content: Recreate your original key images in a 70s–80s anime style first, then use Seedance’s In-Between Method to build the sequence for more complex scenes with continuity between shots and a classic anime look.
tips: Recreate your original key images in a 70s–80s anime style first, then use Seedance’s In-Between Method to build the sequence for more complex scenes with continuity between shots and a classic anime look.

es.content: Recrea primero tus imágenes clave originales en un estilo de anime de los años 70 y 80, y luego usa el método In-Between de Seedance para construir la secuencia de escenas más complejas, con continuidad entre planos y un aspecto clásico de anime.

fr.content: Recréez d’abord vos images clés originales dans un style anime des années 70–80, puis utilisez la méthode In-Between de Seedance pour construire la séquence de scènes plus complexes, avec une continuité entre les plans et un rendu anime classique.

ja.content: まず、元のキービジュアルを70〜80年代のアニメスタイルで再現し、その後、SeedanceのIn-Between Methodを使ってシーケンスを構築します。これにより、ショット間の連続性を保ちながら、より複雑なシーンをクラシックなアニメ調で表現できます。

ko.content: 먼저 원본 키 이미지를 70~80년대 애니메이션 스타일로 재현한 다음, Seedance의 In-Between Method를 사용해 시퀀스를 구성하면 샷 간의 연속성이 살아 있는 더 복잡한 장면도 클래식한 애니메이션 룩으로 완성할 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Recrie suas imagens-chave originais em um estilo de anime dos anos 70–80 primeiro e, em seguida, use o In-Between Method do Seedance para construir a sequência de cenas mais complexas, com continuidade entre os planos e um visual clássico de anime.

zh.content: 先将你的原始关键画面重现为 70—80 年代动漫风格，然后使用 Seedance 的 In-Between Method 来构建序列，以呈现更复杂的场景，实现镜头之间的连续性，并营造经典动漫质感。
